answer: Layer an escrow vault with staged unlock: each identity's stake releases 10% per epoch, so full voting weight needs 20 funded epochs. A farm with N fakes must fund N deposits for 20 epochs; any shortfall rolls back unlocked share, so capital grows linearly in count and steeply in time. Verification: a threshold-signed panel samples vault balances each epoch and echoes the rollback state into the ledger, replayable by anyone. A new key starts at zero weight until its crystal of funded epochs hardens into standing.
